name: kana_romanize
description: Romanize Japanese hiragana and katakana in modified Hepburn (long vowels with macrons or as spelled, sokuon doubling with tch, n' before vowels and y, optional traditional m before b/m/p) or Kunrei-shiki (ISO 3602: si, ti, tu, hu, sya, circumflexes), with yoon and the katakana extensions for loanwords (fa, ti, vu). Kanji are left unchanged and listed.

text.description: Japanese text in kana; kanji and other characters are copied unchanged

long_vowels.description: mark: macron (Hepburn) or circumflex (Kunrei); as_is: vowels as spelled, ー repeats the vowel

n_before_bmp.description: Hepburn ん before b, m, p: n (modern) or m (traditional, shimbun)

capitalize.description: Upper-case the first letter of each space-separated word

catalog.source: Modified Hepburn as in the ALA-LC Japanese romanization table (Library of Congress) and Kenkyusha's dictionary; Kunrei-shiki per the 1954 Cabinet notification and ISO 3602:1989; kanji readings (not done) as in pykakasi
